There is a continental breakfast in the morning, appetizers during cocktail hour and cookies are laid out until the room closes. There is a fridge stocked with soft drinks, water and juice that are yours for the taking. We were very pleased with the upgraded Towers, everyone should check it out!

We just got back from a great weekend in Chicago and have no complaints about the Palmer House. It's very easy to get to from O'hare(the Blue line on the EL train) and then just a 2 block walk from the train station. The hotel itself is beautiful and the staff is super friendly and go out of their way to help. We booked an air/hotel package deal on Expedia. We expected to stay in a room with a full size bed but for only $45 extra per night we upgraded to the Excutive level! Best decision of the trip. We had a beautiful room with a King bed,down comforter,robes,plush towels etc...it also included a nice Continental breakfast each morning,all day snacks and beverages and a great happy hour! We took advantage of this every day. The location was great..lots of shopping along State St. and to get to the Magnificent Mile was a $5 cab ride or a 20 minute walk! We'll be back to Chicago and the Palmer House!

Guys trip to Chicago, scored this hotel on Priceline for $100 a night. Had a little confusion over the bed situation at first. They said they only had kings available even after I had called and requested 2 doubles. After a 30 minute ordeal at the front desk they put us in a room with 2 doubles. The room was nice, nothing specacular, a little on the small side but nice. The lobby was beautiful to look at but that's about it. Hotel is within walking distance to Soldier Field, Sears Tower, ESPN Zone, and lots of bars and restaurants. Great location that and the price we got the room for made our trip. Would definately try and stay at this hotel again.

We just returned from a weekend at the Palmer House. We normally stay north on the Mag Mile but wanted to be closer to Soldier's Stadium and the Art Insitiute this time. We were able to upgrade to a suite upon arrival at half the price that we paid for a regular room at the Four Seasons two weeks earlier. What a suite!! It was huge. The basic living room, dining room and kitchen/wet bar area was one large room. Up to three additional bedrooms can be added by the use of connecting doors. All rooms were spotlessly clean. They even smelled good. Lovely soaps, robes, etc. Lots of large closets. The bathrooms were older but well maintained. Much better than the ones at the Four Seasons. The furniture was nice but worn in some spots. The beds and linens were excellent. Room service was fast. The food and service were great. The pool and workout areas were clean and well maintained. We had one small problem with a burned out lightbulb in one of the lamps. Maintaince arrived quickly with a new bulb. They wouldn't allow me to tip them!! Check-in was somewhat slow as the hotel has been sold out for several weeks. This is a very large hotel, so they have to move a lot of people and rooms. Also, the hotel does not have views as it is configured like an "E". All in all, the Palmer House is a good value for the money.

My wife and I decided to spend three days in Chicago last summer, and booked via Expedia. When we first walked into the lobby we almost fell over at its' beauty. It's like something out of Europe. We were able to get a free room upgrade, even though the rooms are still a bit small, but its' an old hotel in an old city. It's there for sleeping and showering. The restaurants, lounges, and shops were all wonderfull. The next time we travel to Chicago, I'll be affraid to stay anywhere other than the Palmer House Hilton

I booked this hotel for $75 on Hotwire with mid-level expectations for one night. Totally blown away. Arrived on a Sunday night. Gave car to valet ($51/night). Lobby was a social people watching scene with swank music. Check-in was smooth and easy. I asked for an upgrade and was told no free upgrades to 3rd party bookings. Upgrade to suite was available at a cost. I passed since only 1 night stay. I asked for a nice, quiet room away from noisy housekeeping and ice machine. Received room 10-120. Room was huge with 2 beds. Felt like 400 square feet. Newly renovated last year. Bell hop told me some rooms are very small so I totally lucked out! Service from start to finish was top notch. Everyone had a smile on their face. Always spoke with great respect and made us feel welcome. Ordered room service at 10:45 PM. Arrived in 1/2 hour. food was so-so. Had pancakes in Lockwood for breakfast. Very good food and very good service. Strong coffee. Hotel is right on State Street shopping. FYI - Rooms on floors 15 and below were renovated last year. Rest were done 5 years ago. For the price, it was a great bargain! Only complaint is bathroom is small.

We booked this hotel using points on our credit card. When we arrived, we were immediately greeted by a friendly face. We arrived several hours before check-in. However, they let us check-in early. They also gave us a free room upgrade. The hotel is absolutely stunning! In addition, it is off of State Street. There are many things to do - shopping, dinning, theater. It is also close to public transportation if you would like to go to the United Center or the airport. The hotel also allowed us to have a late check-out at no additional charge. The room was so dark and quiet we slept in.

I stayed at the Palmer House for @ $150/night on a corporate rate. The bed was excellent, the linens/towels were top of the line. I did not find my room shabby, as other reviewers noted. The Palmer House is over 130 years old. Rooms have older woodwork and classic furniture; I think that lends to the ambience of the place. It is expensive, and I'm not sure I'd stay there if my company weren't picking up the tab. But the hotel itself is still awe-inspiring.

Attended a conference at the Palmer House and it truly surpassed my expectations. I had no idea it would be so large, so nice and with so many amenities. I also didn't realize that it is just around the corner from Milenium Park and the Art Institute. We were met at the door by the friendliest staff. Even with a long line at check-in, the entire process was about 10 minutes. We enjoyed the room with the up-to-date TV, decent size bathroom and comfortable bed. Had a fantastic breakfast buffet as well as a delicious take-out lunch at the main restaurant. Paid $200/night through the conference which seemed quite fair considering downtown Chicago. We have stayed at the Sofital which is much more upscale, but we also paid over $300/night there.

This was a great place to be! Great views of the city, great food, and the staff were really friendly and helpful.

everything that i read from other reviews was pretty much true about this product.

Had to bring my new puppy with me on a road trip and we

This is a great hotel! The views are fabulous, the staff is so friendly and helpful, and the rooms are clean and comfortable.

We stayed here because of all the great reviews, and we were not disappointed!

From the moment I stepped up to the front entrance , my experience at this restaurant was greatly

I am a fan of Kimpton Hotels, however I have never had a negative experience! The staff have always been incredibly friendly and the facilities are fantastic!

Stayed at the Talbott for over a week and enjoyed every minute of it. The staff was

We booked at another hotel a block away and spent most of our time at this one.

This hotel is absolutely amazing! The staff are so friendly and helpful, the decor is chic and modern, and the amenities are top-notch. We felt right at home and had an incredible stay here.

Location, location, location. What a great find! Excellent, well-run, small guest house in the perfect

The Omni Chicago really delivers on all fronts, from the EXCELLENT

My wife and I redeemed some of my Hilton Reward points for a stay at the Hilton last weekend.

i was in chicago from september 17-22 for a convention.. I had an amazing experience while in Chicago for the convention. The hotel I stayed in was amazing--it was clean and comfortable, and the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful.

Just back from 5 night stay at Omni and would thoroughly recommend it.

We absolutely loved our stay at the Omni! The staff were so friendly and helpful, the room was clean and cozy, and the amenities were top-notch. From the complimentary breakfast in the morning to the pool and fitness center, there was something for everyone to enjoy.

We just got back from a great weekend in Chicago and had the best time! The hotel was surprisingly nice and

The Hard Rock Hotel was a natural choice for me since its

We loved our stay at the Talbott. We were in town for a long weekend and the hotel provided us with

The hospitality of the city was wonderful and the locals were very friendly.

I recently stayed at the Fairmont Chicago and found it to be a great place. The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly, the rooms were clean and well-equipped, and the overall ambience of the hotel was one of luxury and comfort.

I was lucky enough to get a "4 star" hotel room and I have to say I was really impressed with the

This is best hotel bargin in Chicago if you are looking for a quality stay

I had a great time here! It is centerally located and 
the staff is really friendly and helpful.  It was my first time here and I couldn't be happier with my experience.

I stayed at the Fairmont to attend a conference. I was very pleased with the hotel.

The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful, the rooms were spacious and comfortable, and the amenities were top notch. The proximity to the conference center made it easy to get to and from my meetings and events. I would absolutely recommend the Fairmont to anyone visiting the area.

My wife and I stayed two nights at the Talbott Hotel and had an amazing experience. The staff was incredibly helpful and accommodating. we stayed here in january when it was -20. but despite the cold weather,

we love the location and proximity to everything. The staff was friendly

The location of the hotel is great, right on the beach, but

I travel often for business and this hotel ranks very low. 
The room was tiny and smelled musty. The staff was rude and unhelpful. The bedsheets felt like sandpaper and the wifi didn't work at all. All in all, it was an awful experience and I would never recommend this hotel to anyone.

The room was big and luxurious, befitting the price tag , but

Here are my experiences: - Had three rooms reserved, when I arrived the check-in process was a complete mess, took them forever to get us checked in. I booked a hotel room for 4 nights at this hotel and it was a terrible experience.

The room was dirty, with stains on the furniture and carpets. The bed was uncomfortable and there were bugs crawling around. The bathrooms were not very clean either. The staff at the front desk were rude and unhelpful.

This hotel is a shambles-furniture literally falling apart and a pool that was green and dirty. 

The staff here are absolutely useless - they don't care and do nothing to make your stay comfortable. The rooms are tiny and the beds are so uncomfortable that it's impossible to sleep properly. The food is terrible, and no effort is made to make sure that guests have an enjoyable experience.

I stayed at the hotel during the Dave Matthews Caravan and it was a complete disaster.

The staff was rude and unhelpful, the room was tiny and dirty, and the food was terrible. There was no attention to detail and I felt like I was just a number. It was one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had.

While it was a nice hotel, but i am rather disappointed with the service.

The staff was incredibly unfriendly and unhelpful. They acted like they could care less about my stay. It felt like it was an inconvenience for them to answer any of my questions. Additionally, the room was not as clean as I expected it to be.

We traveled to Chicago to visit with our daughter who is a student at the University of Illinois.
The hotel we stayed at in Chicago was a huge disappointment. The room was dirty and the staff was unhelpful and unfriendly. To make matters worse, the room was severely overpriced for the quality of service and accommodations we received.

Often visit Chicago, but this was my first stay at The Drake Hotel.

I was really disappointed with my stay at The Drake Hotel. From the moment I arrived, I felt as though the hotel staff were not particularly friendly and didn't seem to want to help. The rooms were cramped and outdated, and I didn't get the most comfortable sleep.

When you're standing in a craptastic excuse for a shower stalls for 20 minutes, waiting for the water to heat up

It's so frustrating when a hotel posts a deal prominently on their website but then you find out that it's only available

I am extremely disappointed with the customer service I have received from the sales & reservation team. I am staying here now and actually am compelled to write a negative review.
The room I am staying in smells musty and the air conditioning is broken. The bedsheets are stained and there are roaches in the kitchen. In addition, the staff is unhelpful and downright rude. I understand that this is a budget hotel, but I expected better for the price.

Stayed at the Fitzpatrick as a result of all of the positive reviews and it was an absolute disaster!

From the moment we arrived, we were met with the worst customer service. Our rooms had not been properly cleaned and there was an awful smell in the hallways. The bed was uncomfortable and the walls were paper thin, so we heard noise from every room.

The hotel staff were unhelpful and unfriendly. The room was not what was advertised in the photos and had some major maintenance issues. There were holes in the walls and the bathroom was disgusting. The bedding and towels provided were old and clearly not washed properly.

Elegant lobby, comfy beds, nice sheets but, we were given a room with a broken

This was the 2nd time that we have stayed at this hotel and I have to say that it was even worse than the last.

The room we had was tiny and the air-conditioning didn't seem to be working properly. The bed was uncomfortable and sheets were gross.

Attended a wedding in Chicago; Sofitel is new, humming, very impressive

The Sofitel in Chicago was a pretty disappointing experience. The hotel is brand new, but it already seems to be overwhelmed. The staff were all so busy that it felt like nobody had time to help us. Ok, I just feel if you're paying well over $200 for a night in this hotel, you expect more than what I got. The bed was way too soft, the rooms were quite small and they had no Wi-Fi connection whatsoever. It was a complete waste of money and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

When you check into a hotel after being stuck in traffic for hours,

My husband and i made a reservation for 2sure nights at

Staying here currently. Had aspired to sleep. The paper thin walls have allowed me to hear every single noise, including the loud conversation from the hallway.

When the server finally did come, the attitude wasn't great and the service was slow. The food was ok but nothing particularly special. I felt like I had to fight for attention and overall I was really disappointed with my experience here.

So...the location to the Clark/Lake train stop is great...and that 's about it

The hotel itself is really disappointing. The rooms are dirty and outdated and I couldn't even get the TV to turn on. The staff is extremely unhelpful and it made me feel like my concerns weren't even important. The breakfast was barely edible and I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone.

Swissotel continues to be a *yawn* As previous posters state, the service was slow, the food was subpar, and the price was far too expensive for what we received.

It's become clear that Swissotel is not the luxurious experience I had in mind when I booked my stay - far from it. The rooms were cramped and uncomfortable, and the amenities were lackluster at best.

Stayed here in November 2011 on a leisure trip to the area.

Very disappointed in our stay in Chicago Monoco. We have had much better

After checking out of the Sofitel Chicago Water Tower the last thing I expected was for there to be

I stayed at the Hilton Chicago because I was attending a business conference nearby. However, I was disappointed with my experience. The room was dirty and the staff was unhelpful. Rude, rude, rude! We stayed here on July 4th weekend. The staff was the absolute worst I have ever experienced.

The hotel was dirty and run down; it seemed as though no effort had been made to update the place in years. The room was tiny and the bed was uncomfortable. The bathroom was unkempt and the amenities were meager. The air conditioner was broken and the room was stuffy.

Stayed for a week last month. Can't beat the location , but the staff was

Unhelpful, and the rooms were small and cramped. There were no amenities and the service was slow. There were plenty of things that needed to be improved, and overall, it was a very unpleasant stay.

We were encouraged to stay at the Affinia as part of a three day business trip. 

Unfortunately, our stay at the Affinia did not live up to our expectations. The room was small and claustrophobic, with an unpleasant musty smell. The beds were uncomfortable and the cleaning service was poor. The wifi connection was unreliable and the staff were unhelpful.

Let me start by saying we are seasoned travelers who expect a certain standard of quality.

We were sorely disappointed by our stay at this hotel. From the moment we checked in, the staff was unhelpful and uninterested in making our stay pleasant. The room itself was outdated and unclean - the furniture was dust-laden and the floors were grimy.

We stay at the Palmer House when we attend conferences in Chicago.

Unfortunately, this time our stay at the Palmer House was an unpleasant experience. The staff was extremely unhelpful and it was difficult to get any assistance. The room we stayed in was incredibly hot and stuffy, and the small window in the room didn't allow for any fresh air.

I have been meaning to write a review of the restaurant but I have been putting it off because I had such a bad experience. The service was terrible, and the food was even worse. The waiter was inattentive and seemed completely disinterested in our presence. The food was cold and flavourless and took a very long time to come out.

Rooms are so dark we had to insist they bring extra lamps

I can see how this place must have been gorgeous before, but now it's

We will not be returning to this hotel.

Me and my husband stayed in the Allegro Hotel Chicago last weekend and it was

As a frequent traveler for work, I stay at many hotels and I was disappointed with my stay at this one. The room was dirty and outdated, and the staff was unprofessional and unhelpful.

The staff at the Hotel Allegro were incredibly unhelpful; they were rude, unprofessional, and completely oblivious to our needs. We were often ignored or given wrong information. The amenities were not up to par either, and there were not enough staff members to assist us.

no bell boys there when you need them, sully staff, and really expensive prices

Fairmont Hotels are generally my preferred choice, but this was an exception. The room was

As a regular visitor to Chicago and a freuent guest at the Hotel Athens,

My family booked five nitghts at the Omni Chicago for our vacation. Unfortunately, our stay was far from enjoyable. The room was outdated and not up to the standards we expected. The hotel is almost always very helpful. This stay caused quite the opposite.

The staff at this hotel were completely unhelpful and uninterested in helping me. They took forever to get me checked in, and when I finally got to my room, it was dirty and unkempt. I left feeling frustrated and unsatisfied with my stay.

Ideal location right in the heart of the Near North Side, however

where do I start. The GM was a nice guy but

great bed, but when I first came in, I requested the non-smoking section and

This place had character I'll give it that. But it was

The Talbott Hotel itself is a bit worn around the edges, and the room we stayed in was

I travelled to Chicago last week with my daughter for an event. My daughter is a very creative artist and she has been very successful in the past, so I had confidence in her abilities and I was looking forward to seeing how her abilities stacked up in the big city.

I only stayed out with my boyfriend for one night, in an effort to avoid going on one, for two reasons. One is that we've made a pact not to go out until we're completely done, and two is that it's not like us to go out or not have a good time.

If you have not tried the Millennium Knickerbocker for a while, consider getting one now to give the old lady the spanking she should be getting. If you prefer the real-life spanking to a computer-generated account, go ahead and send it to me for my testimonial. If you prefer the two forms of punishment to be separate, that's a plus as well.

We just got back from a great weekend in Chicago. Our daughter's band played at the Ravin' In's music festival. They were fantastic! Everything was very well organized and the venue staff was very nice to us.

I have just returned from a lovely shopping trip to Weston Village and have just been to the Berrow Bakery and Patissiere and I need to say that I was blown away by the bread! It was so nice and soft and flavorful and not too sweet. The Butter Cake was also very tasty but the star of the show was the Berrow Bread.

My stay at the The James was perfect. My room was spacious, comfortable and well equipped. The facilities, breakfast and service were exceptional. I would definitely recommend the James to friends and family. I would also like to thank the team in the reception who were very friendly and helpful.

We visited for my 40th birthday. We had never been down to this location before and were pretty excited to check out this new place. Of course, we were a little nervous as it is always scary trying a new place but we really didn't expect to enjoy it this much.
We stayed at the Conrad for only one evening but I need to assure you that it was a great experience.

We got an outstanding rate by signing up for the Advanced Promotions option. We can highly recommend EasyPromoCodes.com to anyone who needs to quickly and easily generate offers and promotions for their business!
We just arrived from a 3 nights stay at the Beach Cafe and we could not be happier! The staff were friendly and welcoming and the spacious rooms are perfect for a family or small group of friends.

My company booked our group for a Conference and Sales Meeting in Lisbon during the summer. After some research we decided on Pax Galera, that had a great reputation and a good price for our dates. I ordered four tickets for our group (15 people) and paid with PayPal.

My family and I stayed at this hotel during an overnight business trip. The hotel is in a great location, just a short walk from the downtown tourist locations and offers a free shuttle service to the airport. It also has a good restaurant and bar.
Stayed here with friends for a long weekend in August.
A very nice hotel with small but adequate rooms. The place is a few minutes from the metro, but is quite secluded. The staff is friendly, and the price is fair, too. Overall, a good experience!
I just returned from a stay at this fabulous hotel.

I was attending a training conference in Chicago and opted to go for a 5K run instead as I wanted to get some exercise and lose some weight. I was very nervous about running in a big city because I've never done it before but the 5K route was a flat and well-marked course so I was feeling more relaxed and comfortable.
I stayed here for 2 nights in May 2008. I wanted to...

After reading the reviews on this hotel, I decided to book with this hotel. The hotel was clean, the room was cleaned daily and they had a nice swimming pool. I will book again with this hotel, considering the other users' reviews are very positive.

When making my reservation, I made it for one of my kids (who was almost four at the time). It was the first time we ever used the hotel's in-room spa services. We reserved online, and we were assigned an in-room massage therapist. We arrived early, and the service was already booked by another client.
We just got back from 3 nights at the Sofitel. The views from our balcony are stunning and the staff are friendly and efficient. We will definitely be back!

Stayed at the Chicago Hilton for three nights and from the first moment I checked in to check out I was made to feel so important. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful when I first arrived. The room was very nice and the breakfast was excellent. Our room was very clean, with all necessary amenities, the beds very comfortable, the sheets spotless, everything was spot on.
Just returned from 2 nights at the Ambassador and I have but to say that once again the staff at the Ambassador was excellent. I will not hesitate to recommend this hotel to all my friends.
Stayed here on business a few nights and really liked it. The staff is really friendly and accommodating.

The Affinia is virtually the perfect hotel for a visit or stay in Ramsgate. The location is superb and the rooms are clean, comfortable and spacious. The food is of good quality and the service was professional and polite. We would most certainly stay again.

We usually stay at the Sofitel but thought we would mention we had a view of the courtyard garden and it was lovely at night. The hotel staff were really helpful with the check-in area and the reception is very friendly. The accommodation was spotless and clean. The breakfast was really good, it was very varied and well-balanced with plenty of options.

I travel a lot for business and quite frankly, my iPad Pro 11's 'wobbly' hinge is the most annoying problem I've ever had with an ultrabook. I cannot even watch movies or streaming videos because the wobble never lies down the same way at the same time.

This lovely hotel has only six floors, making it easy to find. The rooms are small but the bathrooms large and have a rain shower and hairdryer. The owners have made a lot of effort into making each room feel homely. Overall, the hotel has a good service and value for money. The breakfast is excellent and the breakfast menu has something for everyone.

We've just returned from a two night stay at the Marriott in Newquay. Our room was lovely and big, with a spa bath which was a real treat. The bed was also very comfortable (as were the pillows, which are always a plus).

The recently remodeled Affina was amazing - from the 60s/70s vibe of the décor to the cuisine. The restaurant had been closed for years and it really was the best restaurant in town. The service from the owners was also exceptional. The only negative - the parking.

My husband and I were in the Fairmont Chicago recently. The staff was friendly and the food was delicious. We had the Lobster Mac n Cheese and the filet mignon. The service was good but slow. We had the 9:30 reservation but it was taken by 10:20. The room smelled of smoke and the air con was running all night.
Great location - right on the Chicago River - away from all the tourist traps.

Upon check in - the lobby was BUSY! I was immediately welcomed in and looked after with a smile and a kind word. I will be recommending your service to friends and family. My room is clean and tidy with enough room for my weekly office supplies.
After some deliberation I booked the Sofitel Water Tower Place. The staff were very helpful and the rooms were beautiful.

I visited Chicago with my two teenage daughters. Homewood Suites provided a very good value for the price we paid. As a family of travelers, we expected more from the accomodation and Homewood did not disappoint! The room was clean, the beds comfortable, and the bathrooms were nicely decorated and well equipped. The staff was friendly and helpful, and the breakfast was good.
Our third stay at the Homewood Suites Chicago proved to be the best so far!

I stayed at the Allegro for several days in August 2011. The room was very clean, and my room key was included in the price. They provided a key card on the key, which I gave to the front desk. The front desk person gave me access to an adjacent room for a different friend and I. I have photos of the room.
I travelled to Illinois from the UK on business, and had been to Chicago several times previously. This time however, was a bit different. I went there for a holiday.

Ambassador East is an awesome hotel!!! Understand that this hotel is extremely popular and can be quite busy - I took my two kids here during the week, on a Sunday. We arrived at 6pm - no problems at all. The check in time was 2pm - I would recommend waiting one hour before check in though - it was so busy we had to go through our booking and sign in multiple times.

I stayed for four nights while attending a conference. The hotel was great. I had an 11th floor suite and my room was large, comfortable, and had a great view. However, the hotel did not have an elevator -- especially after I had told the front desk that I wanted an elevator. They offered to fix the issue at no cost, but a call to the front desk was not that helpful.

Simply a nice place to stay... I had a great experience. The staff was very pleasant, clean and the rooms were comfortable and were in excellent condition. The hotel was very clean and had air conditioning. I would highly recommend the hotel to friends and family.
Stayed at this hotel with 3 friends or 4 nights. Check-in was easy. Check-out was done quickly. Room was large and clean. Pool area was nice.

Excellent location, feels like a boutique hotel. Right next to major tourist sites: airports, museums, and train stations. Comfortable beds with very good mattress. Free wifi, in room safe & storage. Friendly staff.

I checked in at the Affinia Hotel in Chicago shortly after its grand opening and I am beyond impressed with my experience. The location is ideal and the hotel offers a great service and amenities. The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, the common areas are comfortable and the staff is attentive and helpful.

My wife and I just returned from a 3 night stay at the Windsor. Our room was on the 12th floor and faced the harbor. The view was spectacular! The room was clean, well furnished and well presented. The only issue was that the air conditioning was so loud it was nearly impossible to sleep.

Our first visit to Chicago and I really cannot wait, the tour of Frank Lloyd Wright house is one I have always dreamt about doing and now it has happened. When we arrive we enter the house and it was like walking through a dream, such a beautiful place. The attention to detail in the décor of the house is incredible and I felt all of the vibrant energy inside.

In a very nice location close to shopping and places of interest. The bed was very comfortable, the mattress was super soft, and the pillows were packed with a lot of stuff I didn't even know was in them. Everything felt nice and supportive which was a pleasant surprise given my expectation for pillow soft. The hotel was spotless and I will be sure to stay again.

I've stayed at the Allegro a couple of times. Like the location, and the fact that there's a good choice of restaurants within a ten minute walk, but also the room; clean, comfortable and well equipped.

I was apprehensive after reading some of the more negative content but that was not the case here. The customer service agent was so polite and patient with me. The product was great and exactly what I wanted to replace my broken TV. Would highly recommend this company and their products!
The location of this hotel was excellent as it is just a short walk from the centre of Bishopton.

On a recent trip to Chicago to attend a major event featuring my band, we stayed at the luxurious Marriott Hotel, which was a great choice for us. Not only were we able to relax and enjoy the views of the city, but the staff was extremely friendly and helpful.
I loved the Ambassador! What a great hotel. It's really a nice spot to relax and unwind after a busy day of sightseeing. We had a great time with the staff.
Stayed over Memorial Weekend for 2 nites, 2 rooms. Great place in a great location within a minutes walk to shops, restaurants and the harbour. Very quiet.

I have been 4 times in Chicago, and I have always ordered the Chateau Marmont, the room is the ultimate experience. The view of the city is breathtaking, and the service and quality of the meals are second to none. The food is amazing, but what really sets the restaurant apart is the ambience.
I was completely blown away by this hotel. It was beyond my wildest dreams. The room was incredible, the service was impeccable. I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again and again.

We got this hotel by chance since we decided the next adventure of our trip would be around the town. The location is perfect, being just a short drive from the airport but also having easy access to other areas. The room was clean and had everything we needed which was really nice to see as we were checking in late, and the free continental breakfast was really good.

Review's a little late, but... My husband & I first stayed at your house last evening. We've stayed in many houses throughout the world - and some are nice, and some are not, but this house is the easiest, and it's cleanest too.
As others have said, once all the construction works are complete, you will find a large park behind the new building with plenty of parking and plenty of places to sit, eat and enjoy the view.

I had a large, roomy, clean 2 bed room with a balcony and a modern bathroom. The owner was very helpful and made sure everything was what I wanted. The location was very convenient and the property was very clean. Would recommend to others.
Excellent location, about a block from Michigan Ave. and two minutes from the Michigan Library. The owners are very friendly and helpful. I will be returning.

Just back from a business trip. The Homewood is in great shape and comfortable. The view of the lake is very pleasant and the beds very comfortable. The pool was very clean and the groundskeeper was very pleasant and easy to talk to. The breakfasts were plentiful and well balanced. Service was prompt and efficient. The Hotel is very clean and the grounds are well maintained.

My boyfriend and I were amazed by the breathtaking view of the island this hotel offers from its rooms. The breakfast was the best I've ever had. The location of the hotel is perfect. The hotel grounds and gardens are lovely and the staff was extremely kind and helpful. The overall experience of the hotel is outstanding.

I stayed at this hotel over the weekend of the 21st March and had a great time. The hotel is very centrally located for walking around the city, the rooms are clean and modern and the staff are friendly and helpful.
Very pleasant front staff, wine in the evening in the bar - small plates in the dining room, very good service. Great to sit at the bar. All in all a memorable evening with good company. Rating 5/5.

My wife and I stayed at the Ambassador East Hotel for 3 days, during which we had a wonderful time. The hotel was in a great location, and the staff were all very friendly and helpful. The bed was very comfortable and the pool was great! The only downside to the hotel was the bathrooms, but they were clean and the bedsheets were a good size.
I arrived at the Sofitel for a joint leisure and business trip in mid-April. The atmosphere in the lobby (other than that of the lobby) is really relaxed and cozy...
I stayed at the Hyatt for a two nights on both the 28th and 29th of September, which was for my sons birthday. It was my first time and I could not have chosen a more perfect venue! Even...

We became an Ambassador member just before spending Mother's day with the girls. They were all up for the challenge and had so much fun! The girls have not spoken to their mother in over a year since they left home and they have redeem themselves of all the negative stuff they had done. We had dinner with them at Le Bain de Mai and it was absolutely amazing. Le Bain de Mai is an amazing restaurant in our area.

We stayed in a king suite at the Hotel Allegro in Milan. The room itself is very contemporary with a spa bath and rain shower. The bathroom itself is modern, with a rain shower and bath, and we have 4 suites. The room itself is 20sqm - though the bathroom is larger, as is the entire room.
Striking architecture is only the beginning of what can only be described as an immaculate creation.
our stay was absolutely perfect. its a cool hotel to stay at in

If you are looking for a hotel that is truly unique from the rest, look no further than this beautiful family-friendly cabin. It includes amenities such as an outside fire pit, hot tub, and a pool, as well as the convenience of a kitchen and a full kitchen supplemented by a refrigerator and stove.
Check-in was fast, the room was perfect, and there were no issues with WiFi. The staff in the lobby were professional and very nice. Breakfast was delicious!
Excellent service! Clean and spacious rooms with a great view. Nice and professional staff ! I will recommend you to my friend !

My stay was quick but awesome. After a long day, I wanted to relax and my stay at Culinary Coffee and Cheese was all that I needed. The staff was friendly and welcoming, the space was cozy and homely, and the menu was extensive, making it an ideal spot for gatherings.
Perfect location, clean and courteous staff all added up to a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
This is a wonderful hotel with all the amenities. Everyone from staff to management gives it's best effort to make sure you have a great stay. This property is clean and has plenty of room.

My husband & I stayed at the Fitzpatrick in early June, a holiday rental property located on Crosshaven's beautiful waterfront. The property is a short 8-minute walk from the Pier and is in the heart of Crosshaven, making it a great place for a quick holiday break.

My boyfriend and I decided to stay at the Conrad Johannesburg for our honeymoon. The room was very comfortable and well equipped with everything we needed, and the service in the hotel was fantastic. The staff were always on hand to help with anything we needed. The breakfast was good and plentiful, with plenty of options for a varied meal.

This was a great hotel right in the heart of London that was highly recommended by others. Unfortunately as we were arriving after 10pm on a weeknight we found ourselves with a 3am early flight back to Scotland. The hotel staff were fantastic though, very welcoming, helpful and made us feel at home immediately.

This hotel was great - In a great area right in the heart of the city. The beds were comfortable and had a good firm enough back support which made the night more comfortable. The breakfast was good with a lot of options to choose from. Room cleaning staff was very pleasant and was accommodating with my request to have the air in the room fixed.

We have just returned from 4 nights at the Conrad Hotel. It was a wonderful experience. The service from the concierge was first class, the breakfast was exceptional. The location is right on the beach and easy walking distance to the shops and restaurants. The room was beautiful with stunning views. We will return again with our friends.
I vacationed at the Fairmont Chicago for 3 nights in January 2019. The hotel was beautiful, highly impressed with their customer service and food.

My husband, teenage son and myself stayed at this hotel for one year. It is in a great location and very convenient for getting around. We were able to access the property from an easy drive or a short subway ride. We were greeted promptly when arriving and all staff were very helpful and kind. The room was clean and modern.

We travel to Chicago regularly and have always wanted to do a tour that included the Loop. Our friend recently recommended the Chicago Air and Water Tour with Apex Tours. We have done tours in the past where the tour guide didn't know how to explain the facts.

Hotel Monaco is in a really great location, only a ten minute walk from Nice's Côte d'Azur coast and only a three minute walk from the train station. The hotel has a beautiful swimming pool, spa and gym, as well as a children's playground and free on-site parking.
a great hotel, we used the CTA the 2 days we stayed there and will definitely be staying again.
We paid $75 a night through Priceline, which is excellent value for money as prices vary by as much as $300 per night, and was the only site we used. Priceline is particularly valuable for...

Hi,Stayed here for three nights recently,From check in to check out everything was excellent. Staff were friendly, efficient and accommodating. The room was clean and everything that was provided which included a bottle of wine on opening was a nice touch. Bed great, mattress is firm but that can be said for many hotel beds.

We stayed in the IC chicago for 6 nights from march 16th till march 22nd and had an excellent time. We came home with a lot of memories but even more so with the friends that we made. It was the perfect time to relax after a long year.
this is my new favorite place to stay in downtown charlotte

Just got back from a 10 day visit to Chicago. Not sure what I did last 10 days last month. If you are looking for something really special, then Chicago should be your destination. If you are looking for a fun filled 10 days, you might want to stay away!

Spent two nights at the InterContinental on a business trip. Beautiful building, quiet and very convenient for the business part of my trip as well as relaxing times at the pool and spa. The staff is amazing and the breakfasts were great. I will definitely stay there again.
everything that i read from other reviews was pretty much the same... but other than that

We arrived at 10:30 am on a Friday, and they opened at 11:00 am to meet us in person. We booked with a discount on the phone for 7:30 am, but arrived on time at 10:30 am, and were then checked in at 11:00 am.

I can only confirm the positve reviews previously mentioned. We have 150 active members in our Facebook group and have over 400 in our other group which is based in the UK. This gives us an reach of over 1000 people although we are aiming to make this even bigger.
If you want to stay in a fabulous hotel in central London, we highly recommend staying at The Royal Ormond Hotel.
I stayed here for a conference and got the conference rate...

We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights in August. It's set in a beautiful peaceful location but the rooms themselves are very basic. The bed was compressed and there was no pillow to use. There were also no towels.

My wife and I came to spend the weekend in Llandudno with our 4-year-old son, and I'm not ashamed to say our first impression of the town was not good.

This was our second time staying here. We were very happy with the service and the food. Everything was prepared perfectly, and the staff was very friendly and helpful. We would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for excellent food and service.

We stayed 6 pleasent days in this not too big house. The owners were friendly and welcoming and the location couldn't be better, being a stone's throw away from the centre of the town and just a short walk from the beach, makes this a very handy base if you are visiting this area.

What a wonderful experience, super great, helpful, friendly staff. Angie was so helpful and made the whole experience as easy as possible. My husband and I have been to the gym and have done several workout classes and we are hooked. Thank you so much for making it enjoyable. Will be making our next visit for a drop off.

We spent a week in this hotel and were very pleased with it. The staff was friendly and helpful and the room was clean and very comfortable. The only complaint we had was the wifi was quite strong in the public areas which made it difficult to relax and enjoy the rest of our stay.

The reviews we read were a bit mixed, but I must say that the service that the restaurant provided was very nice. The food that we ate was delicious and they even had an outstanding kids menu. Even though we didn't come really hungry we went back and the next day.

We always stay at the Sheraton Chicago Hotel & Towers throughout our stays in downtown Chicago. Our review mentions the proximity to the surrounding tourist hot spots such as Millennium Park and the Magnificent Mile. The hotel itself is quite adequate and the suite provided enough space to accommodate our entire family group.

I thought the Swissotel was a great hotel. The rooms were well equipped and the hotel staff was very helpful and friendly. The location was great and there were many restaurants and shops nearby. I will definitely return to the Swissotel in the future. Overall, a great stay.
I love the free breakfast and dinners on weeknights. The staff is friendly and helpful. I enjoy the location, the people, and the time value of the stay.

My initial thought of the hotel was, this place is a shit hole that should NEVER be on anyone's list of things to do. The staff is horrible. The room is small. The shower is soooo cold. After three minutes in they even lower the temperature. The bed is so hard. And after three minutes the mattress has to be replaced.

We had our hotel reservations at another hotel set and went to pick them up. I called to inquire if they had room for my mother because my mother and my sister had called in and mentioned that the last time they were there the room lacked a single feather duvet. The lady who answered the phone did not know the answer and would not help me.

Triple A rate with upgrade to view room was less than expected with no complimentary amenities. I would still book this room as soon again as possible. The room was basic and had no fridge, no coffee maker, no telephone and only one pillow to use.
I stayed at this Hotel for 1 night. We just booked online and were given a room number which we arrived at after going through the online arrival process.

My wife and I stayed here for a long weekend last weekend. Our room was very comfortable, we had a big screen TV, good closet space, and a great balcony/patio. We had a balcony which was a plus as we could watch the sun come up and go down from.

We booked this hotel for the second leg of our European trip in June. We chose this hotel based on our previous experiences with Marriotts so I had no concerns about the quality of the accommodations. When I arrived to check-in they were very friendly and accomodating. My experience as a guest was great.

This was one of the best hotels I've stayed at. It was a gorgeous room, perfect for business. It was so convenient for the meeting place. The bed was comfortable and the view from my room was beautiful!
Stayed here as a treat to myself while in Chicago. Amazing shower

The Allegro in downtown Chicago is a great stay/ part time music school. I had a recital for a school music program in the winter and received excellent reviews, and I plan to become a member of this school.

The hotel is beautiful. It is an excellent location. There was nothing that I didn't like. The staff was very friendly. The rooms were beautiful. The view of the lake was beautiful. The hotel offers spa treatments. The restaurant offers a delicious breakfast. The food is very good. The kitchen is clean. The room is comfortable. The hotel is very clean. The hotel offers a shuttle to the airport.

My sister and I went to Chicago for a weekend over Christmas. We visited the Art Institute and got to see the work of Diego Rivera. I also bought a painting of the skyscraper by Frank Lloyd Wright, which I'm pretty sure is the highest thing that's ever been painted, as I had heard the most incredible story about it.

Booked this on priceline for an insanely low price of $149 and was not disappointed (and this was about 2 years ago). The room was huge, I slept like a baby, and the beds were amazing. Can't recommend this place enough. Would defo recommend booking online as the cashier makes you pay at the door.

We had a great experience at this hotel. The hotel staff was very helpful. The room was very clean, the bed comfortable, and the view was beautiful. The only negative thing was that the restaurant was under renovation when we walked in. The overall experience was excellent! Thank you for the great review!

I stayed at the Swissotel for a business trip the weekend of the Olympics. My hotel experience was outstanding. The staff was friendly and helpful, the room was spotless and very functional and the breakfast that was offered each morning was very good. The hotel's location was great and I would recommend the Swissotel to anyone looking for a great hotel.

This was my first time in Chicago and wanted a place to stay that was not directly on the main street. I got a few places and ended up at the Marriott. I had an excellent stay. The room was clean, everything was in its condition, and the staff made sure I was satisfied with everything. The only thing that could stand out were the smells.

This hotel was very beautiful. I went with a group of my friends and the hotel and staff were well organized and prepared everything we need. The room was spacious and very clean, the bed and pillows were comfortable, and the bathroom was well equipped. I would recommend this hotel to everyone who wants to feel home and enjoy a relaxing and comfortable stay.
Great location and quality place to stay. Lovely large clean room. Breakfast was good and selection good. Good value for money.
Arrived on 06/04/05, greeted by friendly doorman, and zipped up easily. Lovely cushions in the seats. The bed comfortable and the wifi free. The hotel in a good spot for the station

Just spent three nights at the Amalfi Hotel, while in the proximity of Civitavecchia, which is 40 km away. This hotel is located quite central and the location is very good. This hotel was PERFECT for our girls getaway. The decor, location and cleanliness were just what we were looking for. The pool was the biggest draw for my daughter and was easily accessible for my husband. The front desk person was incredibly welcoming, helpful and informative.
After reading the reviews & getting an excellent rate through Payhip, I have decided to use your company again for next years holidays."

Stayed here for two days in the first week in preparation for an upcoming trip. Room 204. We had a double with a private balcony. I recently stayed at the Fairmont Chicago and found it to be an excellent stay. The hotel staff, the room, and the location were all good... but the hotel itself could do a lot to make it better.

Stayed at the Chicago Affinia Dec 10 thru Dec 12. The room service staff were beyond helpful and accommodating. They were on point with our cooking needs, and always had something on the menu cooked to order. My only complaint was that the room I stayed in was a bit cramped. That being said, I would highly recommend the place to other travelers.

When we were stranded in Chicago for two days since our flight had canceled we turned to AirBnB and had an amazing experience with our house through HomeAway. They had such a great selection of homes and we were very fortunate to have such nice weather that week.
Great beds, clean rooms, amazing bathroom, nifty view, wonderful service, will we stay again next year!

Having had a great stay at the Monaco last Fall our expectations were very high and so was the standard of accommodation and the services our team received. Our room was very spacious, beautifully decorated and clean, all staff members at the Monaco were very attentive and always took care to make our stay as comfortable as possible.

The Swisshotel is awesome. Very high class. It is expensive but every penny is worth it. The hotel is a bit far from the city centre but the city itself is far away from Switzerland, it is a very long drive, but it's worth it. The views from the hotel are breathtaking. I could have stayed there for ever!
went to chicago for a week in may, decided to eat a bunch of pizza. then spent the night at the hotel. the next morning met up with friends who are awesome. have a blast.
Stayed in a Junior Suite which was beautiful and spacious. The bathroom was amazing with a huge bathtub and shower.

I used to stay at the Homewood Suites all the time for work, but of late, I started staying at Best Westerns. I'm not really sure why, but I like the Best Westerns better. Maybe it has to do with the free breakfast, but I can't really fault them.

We got an awesome deal through Priceline for a Friday evening flight at 5:30 pm. They emailed us an itinerary and a fare with an inclusive purchase option that the airline couldn't give us. They also provided an alternate flight option for a 5:30 flight from JFK to FLL for $110 less than the airline.

Sometimes you just can't find fault with a hotel, even ones that might not be the best. I had a great stay at the Grand Hotel in Omlutna, Austria. I read the reviews on Trip Advisor for this property, and I have to say wow, this is one spectacular property! The staff, the grounds, the pools, the views, The location, and the whole place was just perfect! We stayed here from Nov. 30 to Dec 2 and had a lovely time, even though it was very cold and snowy. The owners were nice and helpful.
